scope.summary: Creates, tests, activates, and deploys Power Pages code sites; can create Dataverse data models, sample data, web roles, site settings, table permissions, Web API integrations, server logic, and cloud flow integrations. Includes ALM workflows (plan-alm, setup-solution, setup-pipeline, export-solution, import-solution, deploy-pipeline, ensure-pipelines-host, force-link-environment, configure-env-variables, diagnose-deployment) and security skills (manage-firewall, manage-headers, scan-site, security-review).

bundledScripts.purpose: Node.js helpers for Dataverse requests, Power Pages metadata, validation, rendering plans, key vault actions, cache clearing, Playwright MCP launch, and skill tracking.

servers.name: microsoft-learn
servers.purpose: Fetch Microsoft Learn documentation for server logic and platform workflows.

dependencies.name: Power Pages environment with site creation enabled
dependencies.description: Environment must support Power Pages site provisioning, Dataverse tables, and Web API configuration.

dependencies.name: DLP allowing Dataverse and cloud flow connectors
dependencies.description: Cloud flow integration and Dataverse Web API usage require compatible DLP policy on the target environment. Not a plugin blocker but affects which skills are usable.

dependencies.name: PAC CLI authenticated session
dependencies.description: Deployment, ALM pipelines, and solution management require authenticated PAC CLI.

dependencies.name: Azure CLI (az)
dependencies.description: Used for Dataverse and Key Vault authentication.

dependencies.name: External exposure approval
dependencies.description: Power Pages sites are externally facing. External exposure handling must be documented and approved.

technologies.name: Model Context Protocol
technologies.usedFor: Playwright and Microsoft Learn MCP integration.

exceptions: Current workflow supports React, Angular, Vue, and Astro with custom generated styling. EDS usage has not been added or reviewed.

blockers: Internal owner and support channel are not assigned.
Skills, agents, hooks, scripts, and MCP configuration are not reviewed against Equinor guidance.
Production-system interaction is possible by default through deploy, activate, Dataverse, Web API, permissions, and cloud flow workflows.
Data classification ceiling is not documented.
EDS guidance is not integrated into generated frontend workflows.
Technology Radar status is unknown for several framework and testing dependencies.

evidence.summary: Re-reviewed after upstream sync 2026-09-09 (power-pages v2.6.6). Adds the `/migrate-bootstrap` Bootstrap 3→5 migration skill and engine, `/migrate-webapi-selectall` to replace deprecated Web API wildcard field settings with explicit columns, and a batch of security hardening taken from upstream: shell and URL handling, export-solution ZIP validation, Key Vault temp-file handling, XSS prevention in generated reports, and a PLUGIN_ROOT-anchored, path-escape-checked Playwright MCP bootstrap. The hardened bootstrap was adopted into the fork's flat `.mcp.json` shape. The telemetry stack remains excluded. 1354 plugin tests pass. Status remains `defer`.

Re-reviewed after upstream sync 2026-06-30 (power-pages v2.6.0). Synced AI Web API scaffolding, additional ALM planning/discovery improvements, check-activation-status and plan-refresh enhancements, Open Plugins metadata, and non-telemetry Power Pages script updates. The new upstream telemetry stack was intentionally excluded from the Equinor sync branch pending separate governance review. Copilot manifest blocker cleared; remaining blockers unchanged.

Re-reviewed after upstream sync 2026-06-09 (commit b4c46e9). setup-auth expanded to multi-provider authentication and SPA flows; adds check-solution-installed.js (reads dev env URL from `pac env who`, enforces HTTPS origin, rejects embedded userinfo credentials) and render-auth-report.js (local HTML report rendering, no network) plus auth-report.html asset and updated authentication-reference.md. create-site SKILL updated. No new production interaction beyond previously reviewed dev-environment Dataverse scope. Blockers unchanged.

Synced upstream commits 3b2009f..2923950 (2026-05-27): Power Pages ALM (10 new skills, 45 lib helpers, 6 reference docs) and security skills (manage-firewall, manage-headers, scan-site, security-review). See commits: 2c82e39 (ALM), e55e1d3 (security), 2923950 (docs update).
Documents site creation, deployment, activation, Dataverse data modeling, Web API integration, server logic, cloud flow, and testing workflows.
Registers Playwright stdio MCP and Microsoft Learn HTTP MCP.
Contains many Node.js scripts that require security and behavior review before publication.

notes: Initial review record only. Upstream v2.0.0 synced 2026-05-27 adds significant ALM and security capabilities (10 new ALM skills, 4 security skills, 45 lib helpers, 6 reference docs). The 2026-06-09 sync (commit b4c46e9) expands setup-auth to multi-provider authentication and SPA flows and adds a Dataverse dev-environment solution check and a local auth-report renderer. The 2026-06-30 sync raises upstreamVersion to 2.6.0 and adds AI Web API scaffolding plus further ALM discovery and plan-refresh updates; the upstream telemetry stack was intentionally excluded pending separate governance review. This record intentionally defers publication until detailed review evidence exists. The expanded surface area — especially ALM pipeline management, deployment automation, firewall rules, security scanning, multi-provider auth, and now AI Web API scaffolding — increases the review scope considerably. The 2026-09-09 sync raises upstreamVersion to 2.6.6, adds Bootstrap 3→5 and Web API wildcard migration skills, and pulls in a substantial upstream security-hardening batch; the telemetry stack remains excluded.
